node_definition.done_when: A test in tests/test_the_printed_refusal_names_its_dominant_term.py dispatches a fixture node over its lane's window through the path the dispatch CLI prints from (the CompetenceLimit message) and asserts the printed message names the dominant term with its token figure and that it arrived as a declared write path; a second fixture whose dominant input is a declared input file asserts it arrived as a mention; a third whose standing context alone exceeds the window asserts the message says no repository file dominates. The estimate, window and shortfall figures stay in the message unchanged. The ranking is routing's _context_contributors, imported where it is used, and reckon/crew/routing.py is not edited. Each new case fails at the base. The negative control is executed and logged. Gate: tests/test_the_printed_refusal_names_its_dominant_term.py tests/test_the_refusal_names_its_dominant_term.py tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py tests/test_context_estimate_reads_declared_files.py. baseline_suite and after_suite are run with the project's armed suite command, PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/test_the_printed_refusal_names_its_dominant_term.py, at the base and at the head, each log naming its revision, tree and literal command and ending EXIT=. Every test file that imports a production module the node changed adds no failure against a base arm: run both arms from git archive extractions on node-local disk with the main checkout's .env linked, record both logs, and re-run any id that differs between arms serially three times on each revision. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Run the gate in the foreground on the fleet allocation.
node_definition.goal: Carry a context refusal's dominant term and its origin into the refusal message dispatch prints, reusing routing's own contributor ranking
